objective: Replace repeated whole-scope SSA binding copies in type probes with parent snapshots and local binding histories.
limitations: One matched complete native-build pair and one matched four-module diagnostic pair; not a statistical performance or CI guarantee.

Full builds use converged extreme compiler binaries, the same frozen workspace and dependency sources, Clang/LLD 23.1.3, dev profile and eight jobs. Each cold build starts with empty target and private compiled cache; dependency sources and OS page cache are retained. No compiler builds, tests or external profiler overlap full timed builds.
The focused binaries use the same operation timers and Clang 23 -O3. Their lowering timer excludes workspace loading, EHIR serialization and hashing. Stack sampling is a separate diagnostic run.

The implementation adds one history index per local binding and retains ancestor storage until its probes are released. Lookups traverse snapshot ancestry and any rebinding history newer than the captured prefix.
Tests ran on native Linux x86_64 and bootstrap in Ubuntu 24.04 / Clang 18 Docker. Other native OS CI platforms have not run.
